card.title: Here We Go Again
card.instruction: Use every new disagreement to prove the same relationship pattern is repeating, then raise the consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You promised to call. I kept dinner warm until eleven again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Last time it was the train. Different explanation, same ruined dinner. Tomorrow I'm eating at seven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll borrow a phone next time. Please keep a plate for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's how I end up waiting again. Miss another call and you're buying and cooking your own dinners.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 dead battery is linked at A3 to earlier train excuse; B4 borrowed-phone solution plus saved plate is read at A5 as another route to waiting.

relationship.evidence: B2 gives a concrete cause and B4 proposes a practical prevention step while seeking continued care.

heightening.evidence: B4 remaining plate expectation makes A5 raise the consequence from timing to full meal responsibility after another missed call.

specificity.evidence: A1 dinner until eleven and B2 no call establish the repeated conflict concretely.
